inputs: First-row relative-minimax seeds from design-points.json, scaled per row before quantization.
scope: Unsigned Horner on all 2^24 reduced-coordinate values; native long-double exp2 reference. Adds analytic coordinate-rounding contribution. Checks intermediate overflow.
counts: Compressor sites include the fused addend. Area prices the live gate graph, not a full-adder count times a weight. Registers include polynomial data plus nine n bits and one valid bit per stage. Common range reduction and output packing excluded from the polynomial/table total.
architecture: Unsigned residual recoded by radix-4 modified Booth. Two's-complement correction bits and flipped sign bits with fixed bias compensation. Aligned coefficient enters parallel Wallace 3:2 reduction. Brent-Kung prefix final adder. RNE guard/sticky and conditional increment. Constant ROM Shannon mux graph. Primitive logic with constant folding, common-subexpression sharing and output liveness pruning.
validation: Small Booth/FMA circuits exhaustively checked for operand widths 1–4 and addend widths 1–3; actual-width networks checked on 1024 deterministic corner/random inputs each. Constant-ROM graph checked against every row. Original full fractional-coordinate audit retained.
early_model: Normalized scalar score: fixed-table binary selection tree, bottom constant-input mux elimination, shared address complements, narrower-operand unsigned Booth row positions, aligned sum completion, data and metadata registers.
rate_derivation: Mapped selected Booth circuit partitioned at final two-row heaps. Row-generation/compression group divided by 352 row positions: 1.56591 register units/position. Remaining completion/rounding/buffering/control divided by 70 aligned sum bits: 4.49714. Separate mapped 32-output variable mux bank: .7875 register units/mux. Minimum inverter: .15. Rounded rates applied across shapes.
